sets.title: The Plant Light Experiment
sets.titleEs: El experimento de luz con plantas

learn.rule: Signal words show how sentences connect: order (first, next, then, finally), addition (also, in addition), example (for example), contrast (however), result (as a result), and conclusion (in conclusion). Put a comma after the signal word.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras señal muestran cómo se conectan las oraciones: orden (first, next, then, finally), adición (also, in addition), ejemplo (for example), contraste (however), resultado (as a result) y conclusión (in conclusion). Pon una coma después de la palabra señal.
learn.model: First, the students planted bean seeds. Next, they measured the sprouts every two days.
learn.notice: First and Next show the order of the steps. Each signal word is followed by a comma.

items.prompt: Choose the signal words that show the order of the steps.
parts: , the students set up three identical pots with bean seeds.
, they placed each pot in a different amount of light.
items.model: First, the students set up three identical pots with bean seeds. Next, they placed each pot in a different amount of light.
items.why: First opens a list of steps and Next moves to the second step. They show the order in which things happened.
items.whyEs: First abre una lista de pasos y Next pasa al segundo paso. Muestran el orden en que ocurrieron las cosas.

items.prompt: Put the sentences about the plant experiment in order.
lines: First, the students planted bean seeds in three identical pots.
Next, they put one pot in sunlight, one in shade, and one in a dark closet.
Then, they measured the height of each plant every two days.
Finally, they compared the three sets of data.
items.why: First, Next, Then, and Finally tell the order. Each one marks a step that comes after the one before it.
items.whyEs: First, Next, Then y Finally indican el orden. Cada una marca un paso que viene después del anterior.

items.prompt: Which signal word shows contrast in the plant data?
items.text: The plant in sunlight grew 12 centimeters. ___, the plant in the dark closet grew only 3 centimeters.
items.why: However shows that the second sentence is different from the first. Sunlit and dark plants had very different growth.
items.whyEs: However muestra que la segunda oración es diferente de la primera. Las plantas con luz y sin luz crecieron muy diferente.

items.prompt: Which signal word shows a result in the dark-closet sentence?
items.text: The plant in the dark could not make food. ___, it grew weak and pale.
items.why: As a result shows that the second sentence is the effect of the first. No food led to a weak, pale plant.
items.whyEs: As a result muestra que la segunda oración es el efecto de la primera. Sin alimento la planta quedó débil y pálida.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that shows contrast.

options.text: The shaded plant grew slowly; however, the sunlit plant grew quickly.
The data also showed that water mattered.
Most seeds sprouted within a week, but two never did.
For example, the bean plants grew taller than the radish plants.
In conclusion, light affects how well plants grow.

items.why: Contrast words such as however and but show a difference. Also adds an idea, for example gives an example, and in conclusion wraps up.
items.whyEs: Las palabras de contraste como however y but muestran una diferencia. Also agrega una idea, for example da un ejemplo e in conclusion cierra.

items.prompt: Which signal word best opens the last sentence of the lab report?
items.text: ___, the experiment shows that plants need light to grow strong and healthy.
items.why: In conclusion signals the final summary of the whole report.
items.whyEs: In conclusion señala el resumen final de todo el informe.

write.prompt: Write three sentences about an experiment, using First, However, and In conclusion.
write.promptEs: Escribe tres oraciones sobre un experimento, usando First, However e In conclusion.
write.model: First, we tested how much water the seedlings needed. However, the plant with the most water did not grow the tallest. In conclusion, plants need the right amount of water, not the most water.

familyTalk.en: Explain how to make your favorite meal using First, Next, Then, and Finally.
familyTalk.es: Expliquen cómo preparar su comida favorita usando First, Next, Then y Finally.

teacherTip.en: Have students underline the signal word and circle its comma in each sentence of the lab report.
teacherTip.es: Pide que subrayen la palabra señal y encierren su coma en cada oración del informe de laboratorio.

sets.title: The Montgomery Bus Boycott
sets.titleEs: El boicot de autobuses de Montgomery

learn.rule: Signal words show how sentences connect: order (first, next, then, finally), addition (also, in addition), example (for example), contrast (however), result (as a result), and conclusion (in conclusion). Put a comma after the signal word.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras señal muestran cómo se conectan las oraciones: orden (first, next, then, finally), adición (also, in addition), ejemplo (for example), contraste (however), resultado (as a result) y conclusión (in conclusion). Pon una coma después de la palabra señal.
learn.model: Rosa Parks was arrested in 1955. As a result, community leaders organized a bus boycott.
learn.notice: As a result tells that the second event happened because of the first.

items.prompt: Choose the signal words that fit each sentence.
parts: , Rosa Parks was arrested for refusing to give up her bus seat.
, community leaders organized a boycott of the city buses.
items.model: First, Rosa Parks was arrested for refusing to give up her bus seat. As a result, community leaders organized a boycott of the city buses.
items.why: First opens the sequence, and As a result shows that the boycott happened because of the arrest.
items.whyEs: First abre la secuencia, y As a result muestra que el boicot ocurrió a causa del arresto.

items.prompt: Put the sentences about the boycott in order.
lines: First, Rosa Parks was arrested on December 1, 1955, for refusing to give up her bus seat.
Next, Black residents of Montgomery began a boycott of the city buses.
Then, the boycott continued for 381 days as people carpooled and walked.
Finally, the Supreme Court ruled that bus segregation was unconstitutional.
items.why: The signal words First, Next, Then, and Finally put the events in time order, ending with the Supreme Court decision.
items.whyEs: Las palabras señal First, Next, Then y Finally ponen los hechos en orden de tiempo, terminando con la decisión de la Corte Suprema.

items.prompt: Which signal word shows contrast in the boycott sentences?
items.text: Many business owners opposed the boycott. ___, thousands of residents walked or carpooled for months instead.
items.why: However shows that the second sentence goes against what you might expect after the first.
items.whyEs: However muestra que la segunda oración va en contra de lo que se esperaría después de la primera.

items.prompt: Which signal word introduces an example of community support?
items.text: The boycott had strong community support. ___, churches organized carpools and volunteers gave rides.
items.why: For example introduces a specific case that proves the general statement before it.
items.whyEs: For example introduce un caso específico que prueba la afirmación general anterior.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses a signal word to show a result.

options.text: As a result of the boycott, the city bus company lost income.
However, the boycott lasted more than a year.
The Supreme Court ruled against bus segregation; as a result, Montgomery's buses were integrated in December 1956.
For example, many people walked miles to work.
In addition, leaders organized weekly meetings at churches.

items.why: As a result shows an effect. However shows contrast, for example gives an example, and in addition adds another idea.
items.whyEs: As a result muestra un efecto. However muestra contraste, for example da un ejemplo e in addition agrega otra idea.

items.prompt: Which signal word best opens the final sentence of a paragraph about the boycott?
items.text: ___, the Montgomery Bus Boycott showed that organized, peaceful protest can change unfair laws.
items.why: In conclusion signals the closing idea that pulls the whole paragraph together.
items.whyEs: In conclusion señala la idea final que reúne todo el párrafo.

write.prompt: Write three sentences about a time a community worked together to solve a problem, using First, As a result, and In conclusion.
write.promptEs: Escribe tres oraciones sobre una vez que una comunidad trabajó unida para resolver un problema, usando First, As a result e In conclusion.
write.text: Topic: a community solving a problem
write.model: First, neighbors noticed that the park had no safe path for walkers. As a result, they asked the city council to build a sidewalk. In conclusion, people can improve their community when they work together.

familyTalk.en: Tell the story of a change in your community using First, As a result, and In conclusion.
familyTalk.es: Cuenten la historia de un cambio en su comunidad usando First, As a result e In conclusion.

teacherTip.en: Ask students to match each signal word to the relationship it shows: order, result, or conclusion.
teacherTip.es: Pide que relacionen cada palabra señal con la relación que muestra: orden, resultado o conclusión.

learn.rule: Signal words show how sentences connect: order (first, next, then, finally), addition (also, in addition), example (for example), contrast (however), result (as a result), and conclusion (in conclusion). Put a comma after the signal word.
learn.ruleEs: Las palabras señal muestran cómo se conectan las oraciones: orden (first, next, then, finally), adición (also, in addition), ejemplo (for example), contraste (however), resultado (as a result) y conclusión (in conclusion). Pon una coma después de la palabra señal.
learn.model: Mateo is a determined character. For example, he practices violin every morning before school.
learn.notice: For example introduces proof from the story. In addition adds another piece of proof.

items.prompt: Choose the signal words that connect the evidence.
parts: , he practices violin every morning before school.
, he refuses to quit when a string breaks.
items.model: Mateo is a determined character. For example, he practices violin every morning before school. In addition, he refuses to quit when a string breaks.
items.why: For example introduces the first piece of evidence, and In addition adds a second one.
items.whyEs: For example introduce la primera evidencia, e In addition agrega una segunda.

items.prompt: Put the sentences from a story summary in order.
lines: First, the author introduces Mateo as a shy student who rarely speaks in class.
Next, the author shows him playing violin alone after school.
Then, a string snaps during the school concert.
Finally, Mateo finishes the piece on three strings, and the audience applauds.
items.why: First begins the summary, and Next, Then, and Finally move the story forward in time order.
items.whyEs: First comienza el resumen, y Next, Then y Finally hacen avanzar el cuento en orden de tiempo.

items.prompt: Which signal word shows contrast in the concert sentences?
items.text: Mateo feels terrified before the concert. ___, he walks onto the stage with steady steps.
items.why: However shows a surprise: he is terrified, yet he walks on steadily.
items.whyEs: However muestra una sorpresa: tiene mucho miedo, pero sube con paso firme.

items.prompt: Which signal word shows a result in the broken-string sentences?
items.text: A string snapped in the middle of the song. ___, Mateo had to finish with only three strings.
items.why: As a result shows that having to use three strings happened because the string broke.
items.whyEs: As a result muestra que tener que usar tres cuerdas ocurrió porque se rompió una cuerda.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses a signal word for addition.

options.text: In addition, Mateo thanks his teacher for believing in him.
However, Mateo felt the audience's support.
Also, he helps younger students practice before the concert.
For example, he plays three scales without a mistake.

items.why: In addition and also add another idea. However shows contrast, for example gives an example, and in conclusion wraps up.
items.whyEs: In addition y also agregan otra idea. However muestra contraste, for example da un ejemplo e in conclusion cierra.

items.prompt: Which signal word best opens the last sentence of a character analysis?
items.text: ___, Mateo's courage grows because he keeps trying after every setback.
items.why: In conclusion marks the final sentence that sums up your idea about the character.
items.whyEs: In conclusion marca la última oración que resume tu idea sobre el personaje.

write.prompt: Write three sentences about a character, using For example, In addition, and In conclusion.
write.promptEs: Escribe tres oraciones sobre un personaje, usando For example, In addition e In conclusion.
write.text: Topic: a character from a story you know
write.model: For example, Mateo practices every morning before school. In addition, he finishes the concert after a string breaks. In conclusion, Mateo shows that determination can overcome fear.

familyTalk.en: Talk about a character you like. Give an example, add another idea, and end with a conclusion.
familyTalk.es: Hablen de un personaje que les guste. Den un ejemplo, agreguen otra idea y terminen con una conclusión.

teacherTip.en: Have students find one signal word in a class novel and explain what relationship it shows.
teacherTip.es: Pide que encuentren una palabra señal en la novela de la clase y expliquen qué relación muestra.
